text:
Samir K: Heads-up — a partner reported duplicate credits showing up in our marketplace reports. They say their embedded devices batch usage and ACKs on a 5-minute window, but our ingestion dedup relies on hourly buckets. Can we triage? :thinking_face:
Lina G: oof. do you have an example payload from the device? sounds like sequence/seqno + batch window mismatch.
Samir K: pasted anonymized example from their logs:```
{
  "device_id": "edge-abc-123",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-22T15:02:10Z",
  "window_start": "2026-03-22T15:00:00Z",
  "usage_units": 1200,
  "batch_id": "b-20260322-1500",
  "seq": 42
}
``` They send another record 3min later with same batch_id but seq resets to 1 after device reboot.
Lina G: OK that explains duplication — our ingestion currently keys dedupe on (device_id, batch_id, hour_bucket). If seq resets frequently we get false uniques. We should prefer a monotonic global event_id or include device reboot marker. Can partner add a monotonic counter or UUID per batch?
Maria B: If we can't change partner immediately, can we apply server-side heuristics? e.g., treat batches with identical batch_id and device_id within 10 minutes as potential duplicates and collapse by max(usage) or last-seen with signature hash. Need to understand billing impact before autopruning.
Lina G: heuristics ok short-term. propose: compute signature = sha256(device_id + batch_id + reported_window_start + maybe firmware_version). If same signature within retention window, keep the highest usage_units and mark duplicate. Also emit "heuristic_dedup" tag to ledger for auditing.
Alex P: quick questions for partner ops playbook: can we get them to include a batch_uuid in next firmware? timeframe? also need a backfill plan for already-duplicated invoices.
Samir K: partner said firmware sprint next month but can toggle debug flag to include batch_uuid earlier for subset of devices. They want us to run a conservative backfill and then reconcile.
Maria B: For backfill, run: 1) identify candidate duplicate groups (same device_id + batch_id within 24h) 2) collapse per-group using signature heuristic 3) produce provisional credit file and send to partner for sign-off 4) apply credits in next billing cycle with audit trail.
Lina G: Implementation notes for eng: 1) add "heuristic_dedup_v1" pipeline stage that computes signature and groupings, 2) add a flag to mark records as "candidate_duplicate", 3) surface counts in the marketplace dashboard (per-partner duplicate rate) so product/sales can monitor.
eng-ops-bot: deploy queued: feature/heuristic-dedupe branch -> staging (CI pass). ETA 2h. :rocket:
Alex P: thx all. I'll coordinate partner test cohort (5K devices) and schedule a midweek sync after staging run. Samir — can you own partner comms?
Samir K: on it. will post test matrix and sample expected results here once partner flips flag. :thumbsup:
Maria B: tagging billing: we'll prepare provisional credit format. sample CSV columns: invoice_id, partner_id, device_id, original_amount, credit_amount, reason, audit_signature.
Lina G: adding one more edgecase — if device reboots and seq restarts but batch_id changes (they derive batch_id from local clock) we could still get out-of-order windows. include firmware_version + uptime_seconds in signature if available.
Samir K: noted. thanks everyone — will create follow-up thread with test results. :white_check_mark:
